description: Result of a configuration test (POST /nginx/<host type>/test). Nothing was saved and nginx was not reloaded.

ok.description: Nginx accepts the configuration as entered: the host would be online and no custom location would be quarantined. Unresolved locations and unreachable upstreams don't fail the test.

nginx_online.description: False when nginx rejects the host itself; a save would fail with nginx_err

nginx_err.description: Why nginx rejects the host, the message a save would fail with

nginx_details.description: Structured details of nginx_err, same shape as error.details of a failed save

nginx_locations.description: One entry per custom location (proxy hosts), same shape as meta.nginx_locations of a saved host. Also filled in when nginx rejects the host.

upstreams.description: Reachability of the main forward target and every enabled custom location (proxy hosts) or the forwarding target (TCP streams)

ok.description: True when a TCP connection could be opened

code.description: Machine readable result. resolver_mismatch is ok:true but only works with a static upstream. rate_limited: not probed, the user's upstream check budget (shared with /upstreams/check) is used up

resolver_ok.description: Resolves through nginx's resolver (null: IP literal, or no resolver configured)

system_ok.description: Resolves through the system resolver incl. /etc/hosts (null: IP literal)

location_index.description: Index of the custom location this target belongs to, null for the main target

warnings.description: Things a save would do besides saving this host

example.message: A new certificate is requested when you save.

message.example: Nginx rejects the current configuration of Proxy host #4: unknown directive "proxy_passs". Saving would repair or disable it.
